definitions.explanation: A shallow pool of hot spring water or heated water designed for soaking the feet while sitting. Commonly found at hot spring resorts, train stations, and tourist spots in Japan, often free to use.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{足湯|あしゆ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a free foot bath in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{足湯|あしゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かって→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took a break during my walk by soaking my feet in a foot bath.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉街|おんせんがい}→温泉街：09228_onsengai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歩|ある}き{疲|つか}れた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{足湯|あしゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}め→温める：02096_atatameru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: After walking around the hot spring town until my feet were tired, I warmed them in a foot bath while enjoying the scenery.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ (foot) + ⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ (hot water, hot spring). A popular feature at Japanese ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧ (hot spring) areas.

{足湯|あしゆ} requires no changing of clothes — visitors simply roll up their pants and soak their feet, making it a casual and accessible way to enjoy ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧. Many are free and open to the public. Some train stations in hot spring areas (like {鬼怒川|きぬがわ}⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧ and {別府|べっぷ}) have {足湯|あしゆ} on the platform.
